problems.quote: Allocate approximately 15-20 minutes per question in a 3-hour paper if there are 5 questions
problems.problem: Incorrect time allocation; 3 hours = 180 minutes, 5 questions allow ~36 minutes each, not 15-20.
problems.correction: Allocate approximately 30-36 minutes per question in a 3-hour paper if there are 5 questions
problems.verifierReason: 180 mins / 5 = 36 mins; original 15-20 is wrong, correction 30-36 is accurate.

problems.quote: lesions above the geniculate ganglion spare taste to the anterior two‑thirds of the tongue
problems.problem: Facial nerve lesions proximal to the geniculate ganglion affect the chorda tympani and cause loss of taste, not spare it.
problems.correction: lesions above the geniculate ganglion cause loss of taste to the anterior two‑thirds of the tongue
problems.verifierReason: Original wrong: lesions proximal to geniculate ganglion interrupt chorda tympani fibers causing taste loss; correction accurately states this.

problems.quote: lower motor neuron lesions spare forehead wrinkling, whereas upper motor neuron lesions preserve it
problems.problem: Lower motor neuron (LMN) facial lesions cause loss of forehead wrinkling; upper motor neuron (UMN) lesions spare forehead wrinkling due to bilateral innervation. The statement reverses the clinical findings.
problems.correction: lower motor neuron lesions abolish forehead wrinkling, whereas upper motor neuron lesions spare it
problems.verifierReason: Original reverses findings: LMN lesions abolish forehead wrinkling, UMN lesions spare it due to bilateral innervation; correction is accurate.

problems.quote: proximal NHE3 and HCO₃⁻/Cl⁻ exchanger (AE1) reclaim filtered bicarbonate
problems.problem: AE1 (SLC4A1) is the Cl⁻/HCO₃⁻ exchanger in type A intercalated cells of the collecting duct, not in the proximal tubule. The proximal tubule reclaims bicarbonate via apical NHE3 and basolateral Na⁺/HCO₃⁻ cotransporter (NBCe1).
problems.correction: proximal NHE3 and basolateral Na⁺/HCO₃⁻ cotransporter (NBCe1) reclaim filtered bicarbonate
problems.verifierReason: Original misplaces AE1 in proximal tubule; correction correctly identifies NBCe1 as basolateral HCO₃⁻ transporter.
